description: Generate a D&D character using the declared prompt and optional structured fields. Entity text is free on every user plan, including Free. Portraits use the account's art preset: the default is free; a paid preset charges its Gold price, shown as portrait_gold, or falls back to the free default if unaffordable. Partner keys are billed from their wallet. Returns a job_id immediately; poll chargen_get_job for the entity_id and page_url. Pass collection_id to file it into your folder. Generated entries are public by default; change visibility in CharGen.

classEntityId.description: UUID of one of your homebrew CharacterClass generations to base this class on (optional)

collection_id.description: Optional folder UUID owned by you; user accounts only. The finished entity is filed there on the first completed chargen_get_job poll.

idempotency_key.description: Optional partner billing deduplication key. Retries with the same key avoid a second wallet debit, but can start another generation.

speciesEntityId.description: UUID of one of your Species generations to use as this character's species (optional, D&D only; send species blank or as its name)

speciesLineage.description: Name of one subspecies of that Species, up to 80 characters (optional)

name: chargen_generate_character
title: Generate character
